_meta.rule: the identifier or test number in the file name (the test-level name rules of spec/raw_names.json, the first that ties, and for PSI-69 also the FLEX number 'FLEX-nnn'); the same rules on the PSI folder path (the folder label; for PSI-69 also 'Flex-nnn' in a folder); for the FLEX test sheets that were read, the CIR test number printed inside. A label names the table rows whose cell it equals. Link state (one per file):   two_labels_agree  two or more labels name one and the same row   one_label         one label names a row (or several labels name the same                     rows and more than one row)   labels_disagree   labels name different rows   id_not_in_table   the name carries a token of the form of an identifier                     that is in no row of the table   day_only          no label names a test; a name rule ties the file to a day                     or session   none              nothing of the above FLEX rule (PSI-69): a FLEX number names the row with that 'FLEX Test #'. A file is never linked by FLEX numbers alone: two_labels_agree needs a NASA identifier among the agreeing labels (in the name, in the folder, inside the file), or a folder whose test sheet was read and is tied to the same row by its identifier and its FLEX number. Files whose agreeing labels are FLEX numbers only stay one_label (second_label_scope says so). Files are listed one per row; a test's file list holds the files whose NAME carries a label of it (the count by name: 299 files for the 17 FLEX tests inside the lunar ranges). Nothing here is a value of a test or a count of tests.csv.
_meta.not_said: A file that names a test is not shown to hold what a question needs. The links are the team's description by NASA's labels, not NASA metadata. 'Video of this test' is said only for two_labels_agree.
_meta.flex_rule_chosen: by name: a FLEX file is listed for a test when its name carries the test's identifier or FLEX number; the folder (and, for test sheets, the identifier inside) is the second label; one row per file, not per file and test pair
